analysis.one_line_summary: Silent UGC mini tutorial demonstrating step-by-step how to style a voluminous bouncy blowout using a thermal brush.
analysis.full_description: A creator starts by showing her finished voluminous, 90s-style layered blowout to hook the viewer before transitioning into a step-by-step silent tutorial set to upbeat electronic music. She begins by rough blow-drying her hair flipped forward for volume, then sections it and styles each layer with the thermal brush using a roll-and-pull technique, alternating curl directions. After a brief drink break, she finishes the crown and front curtain bangs, applies hairspray and oil, and poses to showcase the full, glossy, bouncy final result.

on_screen_text.text:

scenes.visual: Creator in a black tank top facing the mirror/camera, showing off her finished styled hair.
scenes.action: She fluffs and shakes her bouncy blowout while making playful expressions.

scenes.visual: Creator before styling with slightly damp/messy wavy natural hair.
scenes.action: She shakes her hair out to reset for the tutorial.

scenes.visual: Creator drying roots upside down with a black hair dryer.
scenes.action: She blows dry her hair upside down and flips it back up with attitude.

scenes.visual: Creator using the heated round thermal brush on bottom and middle sections.
scenes.action: She smooths down a section of hair, wraps it around the barrel, rolls, and glides it through.

scenes.visual: Styling the side and upper strands near crown.
scenes.action: She brushes through the top to smooth flyaways and curls the ends inward.
She takes a sip from a pink Poppi beverage can.
She alternates rolling sections in and out to build multi-dimensional volume and texture.

scenes.visual: Focusing on curtain bangs and front framing layers.
scenes.action: She rolls bangs forward and upward away from her face, releasing soft voluminous face-framing curls.
She tousles her hair with hands after mentioning hairspray and oil.
She turns around, swings her hair, smiles, and poses from multiple angles showing bouncy volume.

talent.hair_before: Dark brown, chest-length, slightly wavy and natural
